# Vendored browser dependencies

Pinned UMD distributions from the npm packages below, downloaded from unpkg.
Original notices in the distributions are retained.

- React / React DOM 18.3.1: MIT, https://github.com/facebook/react/blob/v18.3.1/LICENSE
- Framer Motion 10.16.4: MIT, https://github.com/motiondivision/motion/blob/v10.16.4/LICENSE.md
- Lucide 0.468.0: ISC, https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide/blob/0.468.0/LICENSE

Geist is reused from the existing CUSP assets, with its license in CUSP/assets/fonts/LICENSE.txt.
These dependencies are served locally; the optional visitor globe loads third-party resources only after a visitor requests it.
